answer: Verifiable delay as an identity tax. Each new identity must solve a sequential puzzle that cannot be parallelised, so ids arrive at a fixed rate. A thread swarm hits the same vine wall as a single agent, and the echo time cost makes bulk registration impractical. Layered on top: Peer-challenge liveness. Concretely here (9e4377): vine admission binds each thread to one echo root, so a duplicate is priced, not merely detected.
